Noah (Product Marketing): Need a tight visual pack for next week's webinar: hero benchmark graphic, one-slide routing diagram, and 2 social tiles. Deadline Wed COB.

FigmaBot: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/webinar-visual-pack  comment access enabled.
LegalBot: Reminder: quantitative claims need a source line with doc link and test date. Avoid broad comparative claims.
Noah (Product Marketing): Posting the eval link: https://docs.internal/redwood/evals/launch-pack-2026 (internal only).
Zoe (Design): I'll push initial comps to Figma and tag for review.

campaign=serving-wins
